{{Quote|A hotfoot chase through the calderas of Magmar will go wrong unless you're carrying a narrow-band spectral filter and a composite armor suit that's been furnace-tested to 1,700 degrees.|Chentu Chek, ''Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
'''Magmar''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="BHC" /> located in the [[Magmar system/Legends|Magmar system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region, situated in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Magmar's surface featured calderas, and [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] on it could reach 1,700 degrees.<ref name="BHC" />

At one point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' includes an [[in-universe]] copy of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''. The included edition of the Handbook was published at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and is annotated by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], whose [[Death/Legends|death]] is depicted in {{Film|IV}}. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the formation of the Empire and the events of ''A New Hope'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], respectively, the included edition of the Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook must have therefore been published at some point between those two dates.</ref> [[Armory Master]] [[Chentu Chek]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] included a mention of Magmar as an example in a chapter of the Updated Imperial Edition of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'' dedicated to various [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] equipment. In the chapter, Chek noted that a hunt through Magmar's calderas would "go wrong" unless the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] was carrying a [[narrow-band spectral filter]] and was wearing a furnace-tested suit of [[composite armor]].<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Magmar was introduced in the [[2013]] book ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', which was authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="BHC" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Magmar [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square M-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
